title: The World’s Most Conga Chesticles
author: Cory C.
desc: The purpose of this program is to work on weak points. For this 5 weeks we’ll focus on chest and tri’s . Don’t run this if you hate having a huge chest. This is the 3rd installment in my conga series. Recommend for advanced lifters that are honest about the rpe’s they use

ex.note: Rest pause through 100
Warm up then hit 2x20 pretty tough. Then keep increasing weight doing sets of 12. Final set should be very pumped

ss.note: Just strait pumping  blood  I love super setting chest. Sli respond well to just pumping it full of blood. This is the worlds most conga chesticles program not the worlds most average workout
Put the dumbbells together in middle of chest immediately do a set of 10 after the 20 . This will also be done at an incline hence the super set

ex.note: Straight up 5x5 . Go heavy but you should already have some pre-fatigue. People with huge hogs bench press.

ss.note: Make sure theses are tough and get that good stretch at the back

ex.note: Treat the 20/10 as 1 set. Hit a set of 20 increase weight immediately and hit your very hard 10 . After the last 10. Rest then work towards 40 with that weight
Treat the 20/10 as 1 set. Hit a set of 20 increase weight immediately and hit your very hard 10 . After the last 10. Rest then work towards 40 with that weight
Hold at the contraction for 2 seconds on each rep and at each stretch

Hard 8’s then do a brutal set of 20
3x10 then on the 4th do a drop set try and hit 20 then do another drop and hit 20 more. My legs have to take a beating to grow so yours will to
